api/shared/sdk_agent_runs.py.name: Starting agent runs
api/shared/sdk_agent_runs.py.description: Queues an agent run on a workflow's behalf and reports back its progress and result.

api/shared/sdk_ai.py.name: AI answers for workflows
api/shared/sdk_ai.py.description: Asks the configured AI service for an answer, in one go or streamed, and reports which model replied.

api/shared/sdk_artifact_generation.py.name: Making files from workflows
api/shared/sdk_artifact_generation.py.description: Creates PDFs, Word files, spreadsheets, text files and images from a workflow and stores them for download.

api/shared/sdk_artifacts.py.name: Workflow file store
api/shared/sdk_artifacts.py.description: Saves the files a workflow produces, lists and reads them back, and hands out short-lived download links.

api/shared/sdk_config.py.name: Workflow settings
api/shared/sdk_config.py.description: Reads and writes the saved settings a workflow uses, keeping secret values hidden from listings.

api/shared/sdk_context.py.name: Run context lookup
api/shared/sdk_context.py.description: Tells a starting workflow who is running it, where it runs and what it is allowed to reach.

api/shared/sdk_execution_reads.py.name: Run history lookups
api/shared/sdk_execution_reads.py.description: Lists the workflows and past runs a person may see, with paging, filters and full detail for one run.

api/shared/sdk_files.py.name: Workflow file access
api/shared/sdk_files.py.description: Reads, writes, moves and shares files from a workflow, checking permission on every folder it touches.

api/shared/sdk_forms.py.name: Form lookups for workflows
api/shared/sdk_forms.py.description: Lists and loads the forms a person may see, including each form's logo.

api/shared/sdk_integrations.py.name: Connected service access
api/shared/sdk_integrations.py.description: Gives a workflow its connected service details, keeps sign-ins fresh, and manages each workspace's connection.

api/shared/sdk_knowledge.py.name: Knowledge document store
api/shared/sdk_knowledge.py.description: Stores, searches and removes knowledge documents in the workspaces a workflow may reach.

api/shared/sdk_modules.py.name: Workflow source loading
api/shared/sdk_modules.py.description: Finds and loads the saved code a running workflow imports, and refuses paths outside that run's reach.

api/shared/sdk_organizations.py.name: Workspace management
api/shared/sdk_organizations.py.description: Lists, creates, updates and closes the workspaces a person may manage.

api/shared/sdk_provider_cache.py.name: Saved data-source answers
api/shared/sdk_provider_cache.py.description: Keeps a short-lived copy of data-source answers so repeated workflow steps need not ask again, tied to current permissions.

api/shared/sdk_roles.py.name: Role management
api/shared/sdk_roles.py.description: Creates and changes roles and reports who holds them and what each one grants, within the caller's reach.

api/shared/sdk_table_metadata.py.name: Table setup from workflows
api/shared/sdk_table_metadata.py.description: Creates, lists and deletes the tables a workflow works with, inside the workspaces it may reach.

api/shared/sdk_users.py.name: User management
api/shared/sdk_users.py.description: Adds, changes, lists and removes user accounts and their roles, within the workspaces the caller may manage.

api/shared/sdk_video.py.name: Video generation jobs
api/shared/sdk_video.py.description: Queues a video generation request, tracks its progress and hands back the finished video.

api/shared/sdk_workflow_execution.py.name: Running workflows
api/shared/sdk_workflow_execution.py.description: Starts a workflow, data source or short script, and can cancel one that is still waiting to run.
